title: Pink Pageant Queen Halloween Costume
intro: Some Halloweens call for a crown. A pink satin maxi gown, a crystal tiara, long satin opera gloves, a pleated satin clutch and hot pink strappy heels make a pageant queen in five pieces, with no sash and no rented anything. Practice the wave in the hallway mirror first. The gown and the heels come back out for the next black tie wedding, the gloves for the holiday party, and the tiara for every birthday from now on, because you have earned it.
